fullDesc: Shakarganj Foundation and NCHD are proud to announce the inauguration of our Female Adult Literacy Center in Mohallah Iqbal Nagar Gojra Road Jhang. Invest in empowerment and support lifelong learning.

fullDesc: Shakarganj Foundation organized a successful Free Gynae Medical Camp at Stationed Free Dispensary Shakarganj Limited (II) Bhone on November 28, 2024. Dr. Zunaira Hafeez examined 35 patients with Endometriosis and Fibroids, Menstrual Irregularities, Termination of Pregnancy and various other conditions.
